data.name: Safah
data.gender_notes: Safah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Safa’, meaning clear, smooth and white. This name is often given to a newborn baby girl, symbolizing her pure and innocent nature. The name is also associated with the idea of a clear horizon, offering a fresh start and a new beginning. The name Safah carries the meaning “Clear, Smooth, White” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Safah usually hope their child will grow to embody clear, smooth, white and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Safah holds a deep spiritual meaning in Islamic culture. It symbolizes the purity and innocence of a newborn baby girl, reflecting the divine grace of Allah. The name also signifies the clear horizon, offering a fresh start and a new beginning, reminding us to keep our hearts and minds clear of impurities and negativity.
data.etymology: Safah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Clear, Smooth, White.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Safah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: صَفَہ
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني السفاه أو الوجه
in_arabic.long_meaning: صِفَاةُ الحِجَامِ بِاللُغَةِ الإِسلامِيَّةِ، وَهِيَ صِفَةٌ لِلمُؤَمِّلِينَ وَالأَذَبَّانِ، وَلِلصَفَاةِ أَصلٌ في الأَلَفاظِ الشَامِلَةِ، مُعَرَّبَةٌ مِنَ الصَّفَاةِ في الأَلَفاظِ الشَامِلَةِ، وَهِيَ مُضافَةٌ إِلى الأَفعالِ السَلَبَةِ، وَمِنَ الَّذي يَغُرُّ الرَأيَ وَيُخَفِّفُ المَخاطِرَ، وَقَد أَنَّحَ في حِفظِ اللَهِ وَالعِزِّ، وَمَضِيَتِ الصَفَاةُ بِالرِسالَةِ وَالإِخَلاصِ، وَإِنَّ الصَفَاةَ فِي اللَهِ وَالجَنَّةِ كَالقَناةِ في المَاءِ، وَهِيَ مِنَ الأَسماءِ العُلا وَالأَسماءِ العَظيمة، وَمِنَ الأَسماءِ المُشَرَّعةِ وَالأَسماءِ العُذرِيَّةِ، وَهِيَ أَصابَها اللَهُ بِالنَجاحِ، وَالصَفَاةُ هِيَ المَخاطِبُ في مَخاطِبِ اللَهِ، وَالصَفَاةُ بَينَ يَدَيِ اللَهِ

in_urdu.name: صَفہ
in_urdu.meaning: مذکر نام جو اُس کے چہرہ کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: صِفہ کہنا ایک اسلامی اصطلاح ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے چہرے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ اصطلاح اللہ تعالیٰ کے چہرے کی حقیقت کو ظاہر کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ صِفہ کا مطلب ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کا چہرہ عمدہ ہے، پاکیزہ ہے اور کامل ہے۔ صِفہ کا استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جب اللہ تعالیٰ کی حقیقت کو ظاہر کرنا ہوتا ہے اور اللہ تعالیٰ کے بارے میں بات کرنا ہوتا ہے۔ صِفہ کے ذریعے اللہ تعالیٰ کی عظمت اور اس کی پاکیزگی کو ظاہر کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: सफ़ह
in_hindi.meaning: एक पुरुष नाम जिसका अर्थ चेहरा होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: सफ़ह एक इस्लामिक शब्द है जो अल्लाह के चेहरे के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। यह शब्द अल्लाह के चेहरे की वास्तविकता को दर्शाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। सफ़ह का अर्थ है कि अल्लाह का चेहरा सुंदर है, बेदाग है, और पूर्ण है। सफ़ह का उपयोग किया जाता है जब अल्लाह की वास्तविकता को दर्शाना होता है और अल्लाह के बारे में बात करनी होती है। सफ़ह के द्वारा अल्लाह की गौरव और उसकी बेदागी को दर्शाया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: صَفَه
in_pashto.meaning: مذکر نام چې د لویې چارې لپاره کارول کیږی

in_english.name: Safah
in_english.meaning: A male name meaning face, symbolizing beauty, purity, and completeness
in_english.long_meaning: Safah is an Islamic term referring to the face of Allah. This term conveys the reality of Allah's face. Safah means that Allah's face is beautiful, pure, and complete. Safah is used to express the reality of Allah's face and to talk about Allah. Safah conveys the glory and purity of Allah. The term Safah is rooted in the Arabic root "safha" meaning "face". In Islamic tradition, Safah is associated with the concept of Allah's face being the source of all beauty, goodness, and perfection. Safah is also linked to the idea of Allah's face being the ultimate reality, the source of all existence, and the goal of human existence.

This name also reminds past generations of the Prophet Mohammad's companions, who held the banner of Safa and Marwa during the Hajj pilgrimage, which symbolized the clear distinction between right and wrong, and the importance of perseverance and determination.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Safah signifies the purity of the soul and the inner cleansing that is necessary for spiritual growth. It speaks to the desire for a clear and unobstructed connection to the divine, and a deep inner strength and resilience in the face of challenges. Safah is also associated with the white color, which symbolizes peace, purity, and innocence, emphasizing the importance of maintaining a clean and virtuous heart in the pursuit of spiritual enlightenment.
